description: This file is a code-behind for an ASP.NET Web Forms page named AdminCourseQueue, implementing server-side logic for handling course queues in an online examination system. It manages session validation, database interactions related to course queue status, and navigation between different admin pages.

classes.name: AdminQueue
classes.description: Code-behind class for the AdminCourseQueue.aspx page, manages course queue logic and navigation for the admin interface.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Handles the page load event, validates session data, queries the course queue database to check if the course queue is empty, and conditionally deletes related data.

methods.name: homeB_Click
methods.description: Handles redirection to the AdminPanel page when the home button is clicked.

methods.name: profileB_Click
methods.description: Handles redirection to the same queue page; seems redundant or placeholder.

methods.name: LeaderboardB_Click
methods.description: Redirects to the AdminLeaderboard page when the leaderboard button is clicked.

methods.name: logoutB_Click
methods.description: Logs out the user and navigates to the LoginPage.

methods.name: GridView1_SelectedIndexChanged
methods.description: Handles selection of a row in the grid view, storing student and course IDs in session variables and transferring to the ShowAns page.
